title: Scattered order status strings that form one closed set
task: The order status values 'pending', 'paid' and 'shipped' are scattered as strings across src/. Introduce a backed enum OrderStatus in the namespace Cases\EnumOrderStatus and use it inside the domain: Order::status() returns an OrderStatus and OrderLabel::label() takes an OrderStatus. Order::fromRow() reads database rows and Order::toArray() feeds a public JSON API.
